name: lucid-reader
description: A typography-first, distraction-free reading view for Markdown. Not a preview.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Lucid renders Markdown locally and never executes document content.

enumDescriptions: Old-style serif stack (Iowan, Charter, Georgia). Best for long prose.
Neutral grotesque (Inter, Segoe UI, Roboto).
Humanist sans with open apertures (Seravek, Gill Sans Nova, Calibri).
Atkinson Hyperlegible if installed. Designed for low vision.
OpenDyslexic if installed, otherwise a heavy-bottom fallback.
Monospaced. Some readers find fixed rhythm calming.
Reuse your VS Code editor font.
Use lucid.typography.customFontFamily.
lucid.typography.fontPreset.markdownDescription: Body font stack. Font files are **not** bundled; presets fall back to whatever is installed on your system.

lucid.typography.customFontFamily.description: CSS font-family list used when fontPreset is 'custom'. Example: "Literata", Georgia, serif

lucid.typography.headingFontFamily.description: Optional separate font stack for headings. Empty inherits the body font.

lucid.typography.codeFontFamily.description: Optional font stack for code. Empty uses the VS Code editor font.

lucid.typography.fontWeight.description: Body text weight. 380 can improve perceived contrast on dark themes.

lucid.typography.lineHeight.description: Line height multiple. 1.6 to 1.8 suits most prose.

lucid.typography.measure.markdownDescription: Line length in characters (the *measure*). Research favours 55 to 75 for sustained reading.

lucid.typography.letterSpacing.description: Letter spacing in em. Small positive values (0.01 to 0.04) can help dyslexic readers.

lucid.typography.paragraphSpacing.description: Vertical gap between paragraphs, in em.

lucid.typography.paragraphIndent.description: First-line indent in em, book style. When above 0, the gap between paragraphs collapses.

lucid.typography.textAlign.description: Justified text looks tidy but creates rivers without hyphenation. Enable hyphens with it.

lucid.typography.hyphens.description: Automatic hyphenation. Recommended when textAlign is 'justify'.

lucid.typography.headingScale.description: Multiplier applied to all heading sizes. Lower values calm down heading-heavy documents.

lucid.typography.balanceHeadings.description: Balance multi-line headings so lines are of even length.

lucid.typography.prettyWrap.description: Prevent single-word last lines (widows) in paragraphs.

lucid.typography.hangingPunctuation.description: Hang quotes and bullets into the margin for a cleaner left edge.

lucid.typography.smartQuotes.description: Render straight quotes as curly quotes, and ... as an ellipsis.

lucid.typography.smartDashes.description: Convert -- and --- into en and em dashes.

enumDescriptions: Even-height figures. Clearest for documents full of numbers.
Figures that rise and fall with the lowercase. Elegant in prose, harder to scan.
Even-height and fixed-width, so columns of numbers line up.
lucid.typography.numerals.description: Numeral style, where the font provides alternates.

lucid.typography.dropCap.description: Large initial capital on the first paragraph after a top-level heading.

enumDescriptions: Follow the VS Code theme kind (light, dark, or high contrast).
Warm off-white. Low glare, closest to print.
Classic e-reader sepia.
Neutral light gray. Reduces white-page glare.
Soft dark gray, low contrast. Easiest dark mode for long sessions.
Standard dark.
True black for OLED panels.
Maximum contrast, thicker rules.
Use lucid.theme.customColors.
lucid.theme.name.description: Reading colour scheme. Independent of your VS Code theme unless set to 'auto'.

lucid.theme.customColors.description: Colour overrides applied on top of the active theme. Any subset is allowed.

lucid.theme.textContrast.description: Softens body text toward the background. 1 is full contrast, 0.85 is gentler for long reads.

lucid.theme.linkStyle.description: How links are marked. 'plain' removes all link styling for maximum calm.

lucid.theme.headingColor.description: Heading colour source. 'text' uses the theme's dedicated heading colour, which is brighter than body text on dark schemes and darker on light ones.

lucid.theme.codeStyle.description: Visual treatment for fenced code blocks.

lucid.layout.align.description: Where the text column sits in the window.

lucid.layout.paddingTop.description: Space above the document, in rem.

lucid.layout.paddingBottom.description: Trailing space in vh. High values let the last paragraph scroll to eye level.

lucid.layout.toc.description: 'auto' shows the outline only when the window is wide enough and the document has 3+ headings.

lucid.layout.tocSide.description: Which side the outline docks to.

lucid.layout.tocMaxDepth.description: Deepest heading level shown in the outline.

lucid.layout.showProgress.description: Thin progress bar across the top of the window.

lucid.layout.showHud.description: Corner readout with progress percentage, time remaining, and word count.

lucid.layout.stickyHeading.description: Keep the current section heading pinned at the top while scrolling.

lucid.layout.showFrontMatter.description: Render YAML front matter as a metadata card instead of hiding it.

lucid.layout.codeBlocks.description: 'collapsed' folds code behind a one-line summary so prose reads uninterrupted.

lucid.layout.wrapCode.description: Soft-wrap long code lines instead of scrolling horizontally.

lucid.layout.maxImageHeight.description: Cap image height as a percentage of window height.

lucid.layout.smoothScroll.description: Animate scrolling for keyboard navigation and outline jumps.

lucid.layout.scrollOffset.description: Where a jump target lands, as a percentage down from the top of the window.

lucid.reading.focusMode.description: Dim everything except the block, sentence, or line you are on.

enumDescriptions: Whatever sits nearest the vertical centre of the window.
Whatever the pointer is over.
Only moves with j/k or the arrow keys.

lucid.reading.focusDim.description: Opacity of unfocused text. Lower is a stronger effect.

lucid.reading.focusBlur.description: Blur radius in pixels applied to unfocused text. 0 disables blur.

lucid.reading.bionic.markdownDescription: Bold the leading fragment of each word to guide saccades. Effectiveness is **contested**; treat it as a personal preference, not a proven gain.

lucid.reading.bionicStrength.description: Fraction of each word that gets bolded.

lucid.reading.bionicOpacity.description: Opacity of the unbolded remainder of each word.

enumDescriptions: No ruler.
Translucent band behind the current line.
Thin rule beneath the current line.
Dim everything outside a horizontal window.
lucid.reading.ruler.description: Reading ruler that tracks the pointer or the focus line.

lucid.reading.autoScrollSpeed.description: Teleprompter speed in pixels per second.

lucid.reading.wordsPerMinute.description: Your reading speed, used for the time-remaining estimate.

lucid.reading.rememberPosition.description: Restore the scroll position the next time you open a file.

lucid.reading.hideCursorWhenIdle.description: Hide the mouse pointer after two seconds without movement.

lucid.reading.highlightOnHover.description: Subtly tint the paragraph under the pointer.

enumDescriptions: Write to your user settings so they apply everywhere.
Write to the current workspace only.
Keep changes in memory; nothing is written to settings.json.
lucid.behavior.persistOverrides.description: Where in-reader adjustments (font size, theme, and so on) are saved.

lucid.behavior.openLinksInReader.description: Follow links to other Markdown files inside the reader instead of the text editor.

lucid.behavior.allowRawHtmlTags.markdownDescription: Honour a small allowlist of inert inline HTML tags (`br`, `kbd`, `sub`, `sup`, `mark`, `details`, and similar). Attributes are always stripped. Everything else renders as literal text.

lucid.behavior.zenMode.description: Enter VS Code Zen Mode automatically when a reader tab is opened.
